translations.translatedText: # Monday 13.2.2023 (radio)

Agreement reached in the retail and food sectors. No agreement was reached in the technology industry labour dispute. The economy of the EU area is recovering. The death toll from the Turkish earthquake is rising. Weather forecast.
Due to a technical fault there are no pictures in the Clear News text today.
## New collective agreement for the retail sector
A labour dispute in the retail sector has been settled. The Service Union and Kaupan Liitto reached an agreement on a new collective agreement late on Sunday evening.
Pay in the retail sector will be raised by 105 euros in June. In June next year pay will be raised by another 60 euros. In addition, workers in the retail sector will be paid 400 euros in April.
The new collective agreement in the retail sector is valid for 2 years.
## Collective agreement for the food industry
An agreement has also been reached on working conditions in the food industry. The Food Industry Union and the Finnish Food Workers' Union approved the new collective agreement on Monday afternoon.
It applies to about 25,000 workers in breweries, bakeries, dairies and the meat sector.

Pay in the food industry will be raised by 3.5 percent this year. Next year pay in the food industry will be raised by 2.3 percent. This year the food industry will also pay a one-off increase of 400 euros.
## Technology industry labour dispute

A strike begins in the technology industry on Wednesday. The reason is that the union of senior employees YTN and the employers' union of the technology industry did not reach an agreement in the labour dispute on Monday.
That is why a strike will begin on Wednesday at technology industry firms, and it will last 3 days. About 20,000 people will go on strike.
Firms affected by the technology industry strike include, for example, Nokia, Valmet and Wärtsilä.
## EU economic forecast

The European Commission has raised its forecast for economic growth in the euro area. The European Commission forecasts that the euro area economy will grow by 0.9 percent this year. Last autumn the forecast for economic growth was 0.3 percent, so now the forecast has risen.
The EU Commission also forecasts that the EU area will avoid a recession, so the economy may not stay bad for a long time.
## Earthquake in Turkey and Syria
The death toll from the earthquake in Turkey and Syria is rising. The earthquake was last week's Monday.
More than 35,000 people have died because of the earthquake. The number may still rise, as more information about the victims is obtained.
Rescuers are still searching for people in the rubble. People have still been found alive in the rubble.
## The weather

On Tuesday a little snow falls in Lapland. Elsewhere it is dry, that is, it does not snow. The cloudiness varies, that is, at times it is cloudy and at times the sun shines. The temperature on Tuesday is between +5 and -3 degrees. It is warmest in the south-west.
